sourceText:
Greek-ish Salad
By: Tracy Koslicki
Published: Sunday, November 16, 2014 - 8:01pm

Ingredients




1 head of red leaf lettuce
1/2 red onion, sliced
1 cup of black olives, sliced
1 pint of grape tomatoes, halved
1/2 cup of toasted walnuts
3-4 oz of feta cheese
1/4 cup of fresh squeezed lemon juice
1/2 cup of good olive oil
1 teaspoon of kosher salt
1/2 teaspoon of fresh ground pepper

Preparation

1 Wash, dry, and cut lettuce.  On medium heat, lightly toast walnuts. 2 Add lettuce, tomatoes, olives, onion, walnuts to a bowl and mix. Crumble feta cheese on top. 3 Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. 4 Pour half a cup of vinaigrette over salad and mix well.  Add more dressing if desired. 5 Plate and serve!

About

Hands down the best salad I've ever made.  Homemade feta cheese and an easy lemon vinaigrette gives it the perfect level of salt and acidity and the toasted walnuts in place of cucumbers gives it a unique nutty crunch.
